steps.name: loaded
steps.expr: const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll('[id]')].map(x=>x.id);if(new Set(ids).size!==ids.length)throw Error('duplicate ID');if(/\{[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\}|undefined/.test(document.querySelector('main').innerText))throw Error('unfilled value');if(document.documentElement.lang!=='ru')throw Error('lang');if(document.querySelectorAll('.qz-nofig').length)throw Error('missing figure'); if(document.body.innerText.includes('{{'))throw Error('placeholder'); if([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-fig]')].some(h=>!h.querySelector('svg')))throw Error('empty diagram');return document.querySelectorAll('.qz').length+' вопросов, '+document.querySelectorAll('svg').length+' SVG';

steps.name: FlashAttention HBM traffic and phase controls
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('[data-fig="flash-flow"]');if(!h.textContent.includes('Обычный attention')||!h.textContent.includes('FlashAttention')||!h.textContent.includes('SRAM'))throw Error('comparison');if(!document.querySelector('[data-fig="flash"]').closest('details.optional'))throw Error('numeric example should fold');document.getElementById('flash-flow-reset').click();for(let phase=1;phase<=3;phase++){document.getElementById('flash-flow-next').click();if(GPT.flashPhase!==phase)throw Error('phase');for(const part of h.querySelectorAll('[data-flash-phase]')){const opacity=+part.getAttribute('opacity');if(opacity!==(Number(part.dataset.flashPhase)===phase?1:.23))throw Error('highlight');}}document.getElementById('flash-flow-reset').click();if(GPT.flashPhase!==0)throw Error('reset');return 'two implementations; all three phases and reset; numerical example folds';

steps.name: attention and every tile vs PyTorch SDPA
steps.expr: let worst=0;for(const r of GPT_DATA.reference.attention){for(const tile of [1,2,3,8]){for(const actual of [Transformer.attention(r.q,r.k,r.v,r.causal),Transformer.tiled(r.q,r.k,r.v,r.causal,tile).output])actual.flat().forEach((v,i)=>{const e=Math.abs(v-r.output.flat()[i]);worst=Math.max(worst,e);if(!Number.isFinite(v)||e>1e-9)throw Error('SDPA '+e);});}}return GPT_DATA.reference.engine+'; 8 masks/shapes, 4 tile sizes; max error '+worst;

steps.name: cached prefixes and memory vs Python
training shift and complete saved generation
steps.expr:
const set=(id,v)=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));};
set('training-mode','train');set('training-shift',0);document.getElementById('training-reveal').click();if(!document.getElementById('training-result').textContent.includes('Нужен сдвиг'))throw Error('wrong shift');set('training-shift',1);document.getElementById('training-reveal').click();if(!document.getElementById('training-result').textContent.startsWith('Верно'))throw Error('right shift');set('training-mode','generate');document.getElementById('generation-reset').click();for(let i=0;i<GPT_DATA.generation.tokens.length;i++)document.getElementById('generation-next').click();if(document.getElementById('generation-text').textContent!==GPT_DATA.generation.prompt.join('')+GPT_DATA.generation.tokens.join(''))throw Error('generation');if(!document.getElementById('generation-next').disabled)throw Error('end');return 'shift requires commitment; all saved tokens reconstruct exact continuation';

steps.name: cache, GQA and tiled attention controls
hover and focus
steps.expr: for(const scope of document.querySelectorAll('[data-link-scope]')){for(const line of scope.querySelectorAll('pre [data-f]')){line.dispatchEvent(new Event('focusin',{bubbles:true}));if(!scope.querySelector('svg [data-f="'+line.dataset.f+'"].hi')&&!scope.querySelector('.formula [data-f="'+line.dataset.f+'"].hi'))throw Error('no target '+line.dataset.f);line.dispatchEvent(new Event('focusout',{bubbles:true}));}}return 'all code links work';

steps.name: answer and persistence
steps.expr: for(const q of Object.values(QUIZ.data)){const h=document.querySelector('[data-q="'+q.key+'"]');if(q.type==='pick'||q.type==='point'){for(const o of q.opts.filter(o=>o.right))h.querySelector('[data-k="'+o.k+'"]').click();h.querySelector('.qz-check')?.click();}else if(q.type==='sort'){[...h.querySelectorAll('tr')].forEach((tr,i)=>{[...tr.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.dataset.b===q.items[i].bins[0]).click();});h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();}else if(q.type==='write'){h.querySelector('textarea').value='проверка';h.querySelector('textarea').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();}if(!h.classList.contains('done'))throw Error('not finished '+q.key);if(h.querySelector('.qz-verdict.no'))throw Error('wrong grading '+q.key);}const key='quiz:'+document.querySelector('meta[name="quiz-store"]').content;const state=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key));if(Object.values(state).filter(s=>s.done).length!==Object.keys(QUIZ.data).length)throw Error('persistence');return document.querySelector('#quiz-progress').textContent;

steps.name: SVG geometry in all modes
steps.expr:
const set=(id,v)=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));};document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>d.open=true);const check=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>d.open=true);const bad=[];for(const svg of document.querySelectorAll('svg')){const v=svg.viewBox.baseVal;const ts=[...svg.querySelectorAll('text')];for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++){const t=ts[i],b=t.getBBox();if(b.x<-.5||b.y<-.5||b.x+b.width>v.width+.5||b.y+b.height>v.height+.5)bad.push('clip '+t.textContent);for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const c=ts[j].getBBox();if(b.x<c.x+c.width-1&&c.x<b.x+b.width-1&&b.y<c.y+c.height-1&&c.y<b.y+b.height-1)bad.push('overlap '+t.textContent+' / '+ts[j].textContent);}}}if(bad.length)throw Error(bad.join(' | '));return 'all SVG labels fit';};
for(const mode of ['gpt','bert']){set('architecture-mode',mode);check();}for(const mode of ['train','generate']){set('training-mode',mode);check();}for(const mode of ['full','cache']){set('cache-mode',mode);for(let stage=0;stage<=5;stage++){GPT.cacheStage=stage;redrawAll();check();}}for(const h of [1,2,8]){set('gqa-heads',h);check();}for(const mode of ['naive','tiles']){set('flash-mode',mode);for(let n=0;n<4;n++){GPT.flashStep=n;redrawAll();check();}}for(let phase=0;phase<=3;phase++){GPT.flashPhase=phase;redrawAll();check();}GPT.flashPhase=0;redrawAll();return 'all GPT and memory-flow mode labels fit';
